Original 1990s shonen battle-anime fighting-game artwork, with the explosive visual energy and hand-painted cel look of Dragon Ball Z era action animation. Angular expressive eyes and brows, bold economical black ink, sculpted two-tone cel shadows, pronounced but believable athletic anatomy, sharp fabric folds, dramatic foreshortening, bright golden highlights and electric cyan or magenta energy. Original cast only: preserve each supplied person's recognizable face, body build, hairstyle silhouette, clothing and accessories. Increase pointed hair clumps only where compatible with that person; do not replace their hair, outfit or identity with an existing anime character. Strong grounded fighting stances, powerful clear action silhouettes. No copied franchise characters, costumes, symbols or logos. No extra fingers, duplicated props, lettering or watermarks.
CHARACTER: The golden cascade. Long dark hair, small gold earrings and pendant necklace, cream graphic T-shirt with rolled sleeves and yellow-and-black blocks, blue jeans and a gold bracelet. A relaxed confident guard that turns into sweeping hand strikes. Complete unseen footwear as white sneakers. The fighting persona and powers are fictional; preserve visible reference features without copying name tags or small shirt lettering.
SIGNATURE SPECIAL MOVE: Golden Cascade: Georgia sweeps one hand across the body and releases a gold-and-magenta crescent pulse toward the right. The other hand guards the torso, with a short ribbon of sparkling light following the wrist. Preserve the long hair silhouette and keep all particles inside the sprite cell.
Preserve the supplied reference identity, outfit and palette while upgrading its rendering to the bold battle-anime art direction above. A bold 1990s battle-anime character-select portrait, head and shoulders, centered recognizable face, angular expressive eyes, strong ink eyebrows, dramatic hard cel shadows and a fierce competitive expression. Keep the complete head and hair inside the image with clear padding. Flat uniform chroma green background RGB(0,255,0), no gradient, no floor shadow, no green on the subject, no lettering, borders, watermark, props outside the silhouette or detached debris. All clothing, shoes, soles, skin and accessories are fully opaque in their specified non-green colors: NO green apparel, green footwear, green reflections or translucent green body parts. Chroma green belongs only outside the character. Leave ample clear green padding around the whole subject. Use a solid clean ink silhouette, without a colored outline fringe. Accessories remain attached to the character; exactly one of each visible accessory.
Create the requested original game art. Follow the layout and reference identity precisely.
